name: Maître de protection
description: Short immensely stocky adult, thick neck and thick black scalp tendrils braided into three bound bunches. COMPLETE sealed practical Yautja biomask, dark steel with bronze temple braces, no facial skin or mouth visible. Heavy dark padded kennel-training jacket, black leather apron and reinforced tall greaves. Holds a compact padded bite-training shield against one forearm, free hand loosely holding a looped restraint lead; all rope secured. Wide stable stance.

Two upper cheek mandible lobes each carry one short inward/downward tusk; two larger lower mandible lobes each carry one long upward-curving tusk. For exposed faces, the four fleshy lobes must be individually legible, slightly open in calm neutral expression. If a complete work mask is expressly specified in the individual design, keep that mask instead, correctly fitted over Yautja anatomy; the facial constraints apply to visible skin only. Do not copy the eight-character layout. Not recolored copies: unique face proportions, cranial silhouette, tendril arrangement, adult body build, work clothes, worn harness and idle posture.
Body three-quarter facing RIGHT, slightly elevated game camera, face partly turned toward viewer so four external mandibles can read. Natural relaxed working idle stance, detailed tactile worn leather, dark steel, coarse cloth. Believable practical equipment; no magical staff, no fire, no combat weapons, no animal gore.
